seo_title: Pizza to take back to Baikonyr — Frnds, left bank
seo_description: Frnds pizzeria and coffee shop in Astana: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, left bank. Open daily 09:00–23:00. Our own dough, pizza to go and breakfast all day.
h1: Pizza for the whole crew: from Baikonyr to the left bank
body:
It goes like this: by Friday evening your people are coming over. Or the team decided not to call it a night after work. Or relatives have turned up, they're sitting in a flat somewhere near the old center, the fridge is empty and there's no time left to cook. On evenings like that you get picky about food. You want the kind that's worth driving across the bridge for: something you can set down on the table, open in front of everyone, and never have to explain why you chose it. Frnds is made for those evenings. We're on the left bank, in Esil district, and people stop by when there are already people waiting at home.

We mix our dough ourselves, every day, right here in the kitchen. This isn't the kind of place where the bases arrive ready-made and the cooks just scatter toppings over them. The dough decides everything: a thin middle, an airy rim, a crust that doesn't turn leathery while the box rides in the car with you. For a group, people usually take a few different pizzas and cut them for the middle of the table — that way everyone finds their own and nobody argues about toppings. Tell us how many of you there will be and we'll help you put together an order that feeds everyone, with some left over.

There's usually something else alongside the pizza. Pasta, if one of your people doesn't eat pizza. Panuozzo: our same dough, only folded over and baked with the filling inside, easy to hold in one hand. A salad, so the table doesn't come out too heavy. Soup, if the day turned cold. Desserts get added at the till, as a last-second move. Lemonade, so there's something to wash it all down with. And one more thing: we cook breakfast the whole time we're open, not just until noon. Which means you can pick up an omelette late in the evening too — for the one who worked a shift and gets to you last.

We're at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, open every day from nine in the morning to eleven at night. If you're driving in from further out, message us ahead on WhatsApp at +7 707 480 92 15 or on Instagram @frnds.kz — we'll have the order together by the time you arrive, so you're not standing at the counter with your keys in your hand. And if you're in no rush at all, stay in the dining room and eat it hot.
landmarks: If you're coming from the Saryarka shopping mall or from the old center, your way is over the bridge — to the left bank, into Esil district. That's where you'll find us: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, look for the Frnds sign.
cta: Round up your people and leave the table to us — message WhatsApp +7 707 480 92 15 and we'll start cooking so it's ready when you arrive.
